trace.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
trace.evidence: frame styles refers to frameVersion; cards Allen Williams worked on refers to artist = 'Allen Williams'; banned cards refers to status = 'Banned'

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name, l.status
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status = 'Banned'
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name, l.status
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status = 'Banned'
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'
trace.answer: Allen Williams's cards span the 1993, 1997, 2003, and 2015 frame styles. None of the visible rows show a banned status (all are NULL), but the remaining 63 rows aren't shown, so I can't confirm whether any banned cards exist.
